paragraphs.en: Play to 121. Discard two of your six cards to the crib, which scores for the dealer. Then turn up the starter. A jack gives the dealer two points.

Take turns playing cards without exceeding 31. Aces count one and face cards ten. Totals of 15 and 31, pairs and runs can score. Choose Go if none of your cards fits. After play, count the nondealer’s hand, then the dealer’s hand, then the crib. Include the starter in each count.
Use the arrows to select a card or Go and press Enter.
